errors.text: The proposed single-phase alloy does not match the as-cast dual-phase FCC+B2 AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA.
The coating or protective-oxide intervention is unrelated to the target intermediate-temperature aging treatment.
The proposed 800–1100°C exposure regime misses the approximately 550–750°C embrittlement and recovery window.
The oxidation/self-healing mechanism omits L12 ordering, increased APBE, planar slip, jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries, and phase-boundary-tip stress concentration.
The prediction misses the non-monotonic ductile–brittle–ductile transition, including minimum ductility near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
The cited evidence concerns different refractory HEAs and does not establish preservation of toughness by self-healing oxides or coatings in the target alloy.
